thread:
Claire_CS: Heads-up: BridgeCore (Enterprise) showing a sudden 48% drop in embed calls and 22% drop in gen calls over the last 10 days. Renewal in ~5w. New procurement rep requested a "side-by-side benchmark" vs CompetitorX. Their main champion (Ravi) moved to another vendor two weeks ago. Need quick triage + retention proposal. @Evan_CSM @Priya_SE can we coordinate?

Evan_CSM: Ack. Can you paste short top-line metrics + link to the account dashboard? Also any billing churn flags?

Claire_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/bridgecore/overview — API tokens active down 35%, embeddings down 48% WoW, median latency +45ms. No error spike in 5xxs, but there is a small surge in 429s last 7 days (bursting).

Priya_SE: Do we have a recent model rollout or quantization change on their routes? Embeds are sensitive to prompt/template changes or cache invalidation.

Claire_CS: Timeline shows a model tweak on 2026-03-02: shifted to `open-embed-v2-q` on low traffic, then ramped to 60% on 03-08. Also a template change in their SDK around 03-07 according to notes.

Priya_SE: That could explain it. I'll pull KV cache hit rates and batching stats. Quick self-check for them: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/BRIDGECORE/metrics?type=kv_hits`

Tomas_RevOps: On credits: we can offer a one-off usage credit up to $8k or a temporary reserved pool for their critical embedding route for 2 weeks. Need acct id and last invoice to approve. I'll prep the billing option doc.

Maya_Product: I'll draft a 1-pager comparing latency & cost on their traffic for our current model vs CompetitorX (using their sample week). Also will include rollback recommendation to prior variant if perf delta >15%.

Claire_CS: Outreach plan: (1) schedule 30min readout including procurement + engineering + PM, (2) offer trial/credit and dedicated route burst, (3) present perf readout and quick mitigation (rollback or cache fix). Priya/Tomas/Maya please be on the call.

Evan_CSM: Draft outreach text: "Hi BridgeCore team 
We've noticed a drop in activity and understand procurement is evaluating alternatives. Would you be open to a 25-min readout where we share a tailored perf and cost comparison and propose a short mitigation bundle (trial credit + dedicated route)? Available Wed/Thu next week. 
- Evan"

Claire_CS: Add: "we'll include a short remediation plan and can simulate expected latency/cost impact of a rollback or tuning" to the message.

Priya_SE: I'll attach a quick checklist for the call: KV hit rate, batching config, model variant percentages, embed token length histogram, recent SDK releases. If they want to self-diagnose: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/summary?account=BRIDGECORE`

deploy-bot: deployment redwood/open-embed-v2-q promoted to 60% for account BRIDGECORE at 2026-03-08T14:23:12Z

Tomas_RevOps: Sent invoice #INV-7780 to Claire. Legal looped for credit T&Cs.

Evan_CSM: I'll send the outreach after Claire confirms attendees. Marking as renewal-risk and high priority.

Claire_CS: Scheduling Wed 10am PT readout. Will update thread after the call with outcomes.
